pkgmetadata.longdescription: colibrì is a pure-C, zero-dependency inference engine for running the GLM-5.2 744B-parameter mixture-of-experts model on consumer hardware by streaming experts from disk (~15-26 GB RAM resident). Includes a Python CLI (coli) for chat, an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server, offline FP8-to-int4 model conversion, and resource planning/diagnostics. The optional CUDA backend keeps resident dense tensors on GPU while expert streaming remains CPU-side to avoid a PCIe bottleneck.

use.flag: Enable the experimental CUDA backend for resident dense tensors (Linux only)
